# Doubled physical-frame control

Generated by `tools/emf_luminance_edges_fixture.py --variant expanded-frame`.
Only the EMF physical frame doubles from the base control. The reference application
opened this exact committed path read-only and exported `native.pdf`; both plain
and brightness-adjusted artwork shrink to half size within the unchanged picture
boxes. Run `tools/record_emf_luminance_edges.py --variant expanded-frame` to record
hashes, extracted native bitmaps and placements. This control rejected a proposed
viewport correction; see the sibling `emf-luminance-edges/README.md` for details.
